_comment: REDACTED EXAMPLE. Copy to config/candidate_profile.json (gitignored) and fill in your real data; in CI the file is recreated from the CANDIDATE_PROFILE_B64 secret. Every key below is read by the pipeline: agents/job_evaluator.load_profile_summary() builds the scoring prompt out of role, target_role, permit, notice_period, summary, skills.technical_default, skills.certifications, experience, projects, education and languages; language_levels calibrates the whole language-blocker rule; and agents/doc_generator.py renders the CV from name, the contact fields, photo_path and languages. A key left out silently weakens every score, so keep this example in sync when the code starts reading a new one.
name: Your Full Name
role: What you are today, e.g. AI & Automation Developer Intern
target_role: What you are looking for NEXT. Postings are scored on fit to this, not to your current job -- if you leave it out, the scorer matches against your current title only.
summary: One paragraph in your own words: what you build, what you want next, what excites you. The evaluator weighs this for role-shape and excitement fit, so write it as motivation, not as a second skills list.
languages: Portuguese (Native) | English (C1) | Spanish (B2) | German (A2, studying for B1)
_language_levels_comment: CEFR levels, machine-readable. This is what calibrates the language rule, and it must be your honest CURRENT level: a mandatory level above yours but below C1 caps the job at REVIEW, C1/fluent/native is a hard blocker. Update it here as you progress -- never in the code.

experience.title: Job title
experience.company: Company -- optional note after a double dash
